data.name: Rewind Together
data.detailed_description:
Rewind Together

You and your companion have been sent on a time-travel mission by a mad scientist. To return to the present, you must photograph various historical artifacts for him. However, some of these relics are hidden, and finding them will require solving mind-bending puzzles across different eras - from Ancient Egypt and the Middle Ages to the Wild West.

Test your friendship

This game is the ultimate test of your friendship - it will see if you can work together, communicate effectively, and handle the pressure. Since you'll be separated for most of the journey, communication is key.

Have fun

You can use the in-game voice chat, jump on your favorite messaging app, or even buy a 20-year-old Sony Ericsson for maximum immersion. It makes no difference how you keep in touch - just don't get left behind in history.

Join our Discord

Are you passionate about indie games? Are you creating your own projects, or maybe you just want to chat about gamedev and art? We are creating a space for "Rookie Devs" - a community where you can present your project, share knowledge, and find people to create games together! This is also the main hub for information about my project "Rewind Together". If you want to stay up to date with its development and participate in discussions, join us right now!
